agent_runs_terminal_completion.name: agent_runs_terminal_completion
agent_runs_terminal_completion.value:
("agent_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "agent_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("agent_runs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "agent_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_inbox_claimed.name: conversation_inbox_claimed
conversation_inbox_claimed.where: "conversation_inbox"."claimed_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_inbox"."consumed_by_run_id" IS NULL

conversation_inbox_consumption.name: conversation_inbox_consumption
conversation_inbox_consumption.value:
("conversation_inbox"."consumed_by_run_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_inbox"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("conversation_inbox"."consumed_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_inbox"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_schedule_due.name: conversation_schedule_due
conversation_schedule_due.where: "conversation_schedule"."active_run_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_schedule"."due_at" IS NOT NULL

conversation_schedule_lease.name: conversation_schedule_lease
conversation_schedule_lease.value:
("conversation_schedule"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "conversation_schedule"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "conversation_schedule"."active_run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("conversation_schedule"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_schedule"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_schedule"."active_run_id" IS NOT NULL)

evaluation_runs_terminal_completion.name: evaluation_runs_terminal_completion
evaluation_runs_terminal_completion.value:
("evaluation_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "evaluation_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("evaluation_runs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "evaluation_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_lifecycle.name: tasks_lifecycle
tasks_lifecycle.value:
("tasks"."status" = 'queued' AND "tasks"."started_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("tasks"."status" = 'running' AND "tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("tasks"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_active_lease.name: tasks_active_lease
tasks_active_lease.value:
("tasks"."status" = 'running' AND "tasks"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("tasks"."status" != 'running' AND "tasks"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "tasks"."lease_until" IS NULL)

tool_calls_terminal_completion.name: tool_calls_terminal_completion
tool_calls_terminal_completion.value:
("tool_calls"."outcome" = 'running' AND "tool_calls"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("tool_calls"."outcome" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "tool_calls"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
